section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section describes instruments used in the current study: BMI was calculated from participants' self-reported height and weight, body dissatisfaction was assessed using Pulvers et al.'s culturally-relevant body size rating scale, body appreciation was measured with the 13-item Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), and body image flexibility was measured with the BI-AAQ. The section provides some psychometric details (e.g., Cronbach's alpha for the BAS = .89) but does not report sample size, demographics (age, race/percent White), country, recruitment source, survey administration method, mean BMI, or correlations between BAS and BMI. The text refers to a single "current study" and does not mention Study 1, Experiment 2, or multiple sample subsets.
